remarks: Flags each root gap at the earliest goal of the block that needs it and does not repeat it downstream. Assumption: a secured goal counts as delivering what its description implies; if only explicitly secured competences counted, more downstream goals would be not sufficient. Main pattern: the derivative chain rests only on the function concept, function values and grade 5–6 arithmetic; no slope of a line, algebra with variables, powers, equation solving or trigonometry is secured. Order problems: 858113c5 includes derivatives of exponential functions before the exponential chain; the derivative function is used before or alongside 01acfcc8. 2143e9e8, 7e613c02 and 1eb7b2ce develop content that other goals use, but nothing requires them. Twins with different prerequisites: 858113c5/623cd47f/9f2fc0d1, 0264591c/f042385e/b43a1e45, 6aed5be9/7c0dee9b, 350fc8b1/2850e8f6.
